description: Stores blockwise 4-bit NF4 quantized weight tensors with per-block scaling factors.

header.num_elements: 4 bytes uint32 little-endian: total number of quantized weight values
header.blocksize: 4 bytes uint32 little-endian: number of weights per quantization block
header.num_blocks: 4 bytes uint32 little-endian: number of blocks (ceil(num_elements / blocksize))

body_indices.encoding: Each byte stores two 4-bit indices. First index occupies the low nibble (bits 0-3), second index occupies the high nibble (bits 4-7).
body_indices.index_range: [0, 15] — index into the NF4 quantization map
